reasons: Status is correctly characterised: original 13.1 grants a licence to 'Customer alone', excludes Affiliates and contractors, is non-transferable and revocable at Vendor's sole discretion — essentially the walk-away position under LICENSE.

The redline reaches the preferred position on every parameter: Affiliates are covered, contractors acting on our behalf are expressly permitted, transferability is tied to Section 13.3, and at-will revocation/suspension is replaced by the Section 13.3 notice-and-cure standard.

The failed minimality check (0.795 changed-character ratio) is acceptable here: the clause is short and its core carve-outs ('Customer alone', 'without Affiliates or contractors', 'revocable at Vendor's sole discretion', 'non-transferable') all have to be replaced, so a rewrite is the smallest edit that reaches the position; no unrelated obligations were added or deleted.
Cross-references are internally coherent — the edit aligns 13.1 with the scope Vendor has already accepted in 13.2–13.3 and does not disturb those sections.
Comment is accurate, concise, in first person plural with the [Playbook] prefix, and correctly states both what changed and the playbook rationale.
